# Prague

> Prague is a compile-time-safe, in-memory event cache for .NET (net9.0 and net10.0). A Roslyn source generator turns `[DataCache]` POCOs into typed caches with secondary indices, a fluent compile-time-checked query API, pooled zero-allocation results, compile-time joins and prepared/frozen queries. Caches are hydrated from compacted Kafka topics by Prague.Kafka. It is a library, not a server: not a distributed cache, not SQL, no eviction.

Packages: `Prague` (facade: Core + Attributes + Codegen), `Prague.Kafka`, optional `Prague.Api` and `Prague.Api.UI`.
Repository: https://github.com/nanov/prague.net — License: MIT.

## Full reference for assistants

- [llms-full.txt](https://nanov.github.io/prague.net/llms-full.txt): dense, source-checked description of the whole API, its invariants and the mistakes to avoid. Read this first.

## Docs

- [Introduction](https://nanov.github.io/prague.net/docs/articles/getting-started/introduction.html): what Prague is and is not, the data flow.
- [Installation](https://nanov.github.io/prague.net/docs/articles/getting-started/installation.html): packages and project setup.
- [Quick Start](https://nanov.github.io/prague.net/docs/articles/getting-started/quick-start.html): define an entity, create a cache, write, query.
- [Index Types](https://nanov.github.io/prague.net/docs/articles/core-concepts/index-types.html): Unique, Many, Range, symmetric and key-set indices.
- [Query Engine](https://nanov.github.io/prague.net/docs/articles/core-concepts/query-engine.html): fluent API, index intersection, OR clauses, pooled vs allocating execution.
- [Sorted Paging](https://nanov.github.io/prague.net/docs/articles/core-concepts/sorted-paging.html): Sort vs SortBounded plans.
- [Prepared and Frozen Queries](https://nanov.github.io/prague.net/docs/articles/core-concepts/prepared-queries.html): Prepare, Build, BuildFrozen, executors, ordering contract.
- [Conditional Updates](https://nanov.github.io/prague.net/docs/articles/core-concepts/conditional-updates.html): generated deep equality and UpdateType.
- [Joins](https://nanov.github.io/prague.net/docs/articles/core-concepts/joins.html): foreign-key driven 1:1 and 1:N joins with pooled results.
- [Kafka Integration](https://nanov.github.io/prague.net/docs/articles/advanced/kafka-integration.html): topics, filters, after-handlers, health checks, OpenTelemetry.
- [Global Last Update Index](https://nanov.github.io/prague.net/docs/articles/advanced/global-last-update-index.html): cross-cache change tracking for incremental sync.
- [Performance Tuning](https://nanov.github.io/prague.net/docs/articles/advanced/performance-tuning.html): hot-path guidance.
- [API Reference](https://nanov.github.io/prague.net/docs/api/index.html): generated from XML doc comments.
